The self-managing agent platform

## Introduction Agno is a self-managing agent platform. Build agents for your company, product, or customers. Run them as durable services on AgentOS. Put them to work automating company operations. - **Build** agents with the Agno, Claude Agent, or Codex SDKs. Combine agents into teams and workflows. - **Run** agents as durable services with built-in API and MCP. AgentOS handles authentication, role-based access, resume/replay, human approvals, scheduling, and durable execution. - **Automate** company operations with Company OS. Give agents responsibilities, organize work into projects and tasks, and configure recurring routines. People set direction and review results; agents own and execute. Agno provides the orchestration and service layer around your agents, making them available in: 1. **Your product:** using the REST API. 2. **Claude and ChatGPT:** using the MCP server. 3. **Chat apps like Slack:** using Agno Interfaces. Run your platform in your own cloud and keep your data in your control. Review conversations, inspect traces, manage knowledge, and track your agent activity using the [AgentOS UI](https://os.agno.com). ## Get started Agno is built for coding agents. Start with a pre-built template and give this prompt to your coding agent: ```text Help me set up my agent platform and build my first agent. Clone https://github.com/agno-agi/agentos-railway into a folder called agent-platform, cd into it, and follow .agents/skills/setup-platform/SKILL.md. ``` The setup skill runs your platform locally and helps you build your first agent. You get: - An API server and MCP server. - PostgreSQL storage for conversations, memory, and platform activity. - OS Manager to help build and manage your platform. - Claude and Codex engineers to work on your code. - Skills for building, evaluating, and improving agents. - A Company workspace for organizing ongoing work, with a daily maintenance routine that reviews your codebase and Agno releases and proposes platform improvements. Connect your platform to [os.agno.com](https://os.agno.com) to start using it. Build agents with code, use the no-code UI, or chat with the OS Manager. Start improving your agents and platform with the `/improve` skill. Keep useful changes and regression tests so each round builds on the last. When you're ready, configure scheduled improvement runs in a sandbox that return pull requests for review. ## Templates for every cloud Choose a template for your cloud: [Docker](https://github.com/agno-agi/agentos-docker) · [Railway](https://github.com/agno-agi/agentos-railway) · [AWS](https://github.com/agno-agi/agentos-aws) · [GCP](https://github.com/agno-agi/agentos-gcp) · [Azure](https://github.com/agno-agi/agentos-azure) · [Fly.io](https://github.com/agno-agi/agentos-fly) · [Render](https://github.com/agno-agi/agentos-render) · [Modal](https://github.com/agno-agi/agentos-modal) · [Helm](https://github.com/agno-agi/agentos-helm) ## What's included | Capability | What you can do | | --- | --- | | **[Agents](https://docs.agno.com/agents/overview) and [teams](https://docs.agno.com/teams/overview)** | Build agents that use tools, delegate work, and collaborate. | | **[Workflows](https://docs.agno.com/workflows/overview)** | Control execution with routing, conditions, loops, and parallel steps. | | **[Memory](https://docs.agno.com/memory/overview) and [knowledge](https://docs.agno.com/knowledge/overview)** | Remember users across sessions and retrieve answers from your data. | | **[Tools and integrations](https://docs.agno.com/tools/overview)** | Connect agents to APIs, databases, and MCP servers. | | **[Durable execution](https://docs.agno.com/agent-os/background-execution/durable-queue)** | Persist background jobs and track their status across restarts. | | **[Human approval](https://docs.agno.com/hitl/overview)** | Review sensitive actions before they run, then approve and continue. | | **[Observability](https://docs.agno.com/agent-os/tracing/overview)** | Trace runs, inspect tool calls, and diagnose failures. | | **[Scheduling](https://docs.agno.com/agent-os/scheduler/overview)** | Run agents, teams, and workflows on recurring schedules. | | **[Security](https://docs.agno.com/agent-os/security/overview)** | Control access with authentication, roles, and per-user data isolation. | | **[Coding agents](https://docs.agno.com/agent-platform/harness-agents)** | Run Claude and Codex in sandboxes to implement and test changes. | | **Company OS** | Organize work into products, projects, tasks, and recurring routines. | ## Tutorials First, [add Agno to your coding agent](https://docs.agno.com/coding-agents) so it can read the tutorials as you build. Then, learn how to: - [Build your agent platform](https://docs.agno.com/agent-platform/overview) - [Serve agents as an API](https://docs.agno.com/tutorials/agents-as-api) - [Serve agents over MCP](https://docs.agno.com/tutorials/agents-as-mcp) - [Run Claude and Codex as services](https://docs.agno.com/tutorials/harnesses-as-a-service) - [Read the documentation](https://docs.agno.com) ## Community Follow [Agno on X](https://x.com/AgnoAgi) for releases and demos, or subscribe to [The Agno Loop](https://www.agno.com/the-agno-loop-newsletter). See the [contributing guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) to contribute. ## License Agno is distributed under the [Apache 2.0 license](LICENSE). ## Telemetry Agno sends a telemetry event per agent so we know which model providers to prioritize. Prompts, messages, and outputs are never sent. Disable by setting `AGNO_TELEMETRY=false`.
